info.title: Personal Finance & Investment Tracker API
info.description: API for tracking personal finances, investments (Gold and Mutual Funds), and receiving AI-powered investment recommendations.

post.description: Creates a new user account with encrypted email and hashed password.
Authenticates a user with email and password using NextAuth.js Credentials provider. On success, sets a session cookie for subsequent authenticated requests.

200.description: Login successful - redirects to callback URL or home page. Session cookie is set.

401.description: Invalid credentials - redirects to login page with error

get.description: Retrieves a CSRF token required for login and signout requests.

csrfToken.description: CSRF token to include in login/signout requests

get.description: Retrieves the current user's session information if authenticated.

post.description: Signs out the current user and invalidates the session.

get.description: Retrieves all monthly cashflow records for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new cashflow record or updates an existing one for the specified month. Automatically calculates total_expense and net_cashflow.

get.summary: Get cashflow for a specific month
get.description: Retrieves the cashflow record for a specific month.
Retrieves all investment records for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new investment snapshot or updates an existing one for the specified investment type and month. Automatically creates the investment record if it doesn't exist.

get.description: Retrieves all snapshots for a specific investment type (GOLD or MUTUAL_FUND).
Retrieves monthly net cashflow trend data for the authenticated user.
Retrieves portfolio summary (total invested vs current value) and growth over time.
Retrieves separate summaries for Gold and Mutual Fund investments for comparison.
Retrieves AI-powered investment allocation recommendation based on user's financial history. Returns 403 if AI recommendation is disabled in user settings.

responseDetails.reasoning: Berdasarkan analisis keuangan Anda, kami merekomendasikan alokasi 40% untuk Emas dan 60% untuk Reksa Dana. Cashflow Anda stabil dengan rata-rata surplus Rp 4.000.000 per bulan.

example.responseMessage: AI recommendation is disabled. Enable it in settings to receive investment recommendations.

get.description: Retrieves the current user's settings including AI recommendation preference.

patch.description: Enables or disables AI investment recommendations for the user.

200.description: Generic response returned regardless of account existence

post.summary: Consume a reset token and set a new password

400.description: Invalid, expired, used token, or invalid password

post.summary: Extract editable transaction guesses from a receipt image

200.description: OCR guesses and a receipt image data URL
Suggestions based on current month versus the preceding three months

post.description: Triggers monthly email notifications for all users. Requires the fail-closed CRON_SECRET bearer credential and returns aggregate delivery counts only.

example.responseMessage: Monthly notifications processed: 5 sent, 1 failed, 2 skipped

bearerAuth.description: JWT token obtained from NextAuth.js authentication

cronBearerAuth.description: Required deployment scheduler secret from CRON_SECRET

PrivateNoStore.description: Prevents storage of privileged scheduler responses

mutual_fund_percentage.description: Recommended percentage allocation for Mutual Fund (0-100)

investable_amount.description: Suggested amount to invest this month

reasoning.description: Explanation in Bahasa Indonesia for the recommendation

should_invest.description: Whether user should invest (false if should focus on emergency fund)

ai_recommendation_enabled.description: Whether AI investment recommendations are enabled

skipped.description: Number of idempotently claimed or already processed notifications

total.description: Sum of sent, failed, and skipped notifications
